title: StackAnt
description: StackAnt is a cross-platform PyQt6 desktop application that turns a manual-focus-pull video of a specimen into a focus-stacked composite image, aimed at entomologists doing macro photography. It extracts frames with ffmpeg, automatically rejects motion-blurred transition frames by Laplacian variance, and stacks either with an in-process Laplacian-pyramid method or the focus-stack CLI.
